review.findings:
All three commands satisfy every stated requirement:
- `rename <old> --to <new>` renames correctly regardless of flag order.
- `delete <name> --yes` deletes; without `--yes` it refuses and leaves the file untouched.
- `undo <name>` removes today's mark.
- All three print exactly `done`'s message (`No habit named "nope"`) for an unknown habit.
- None of them create `habits.json` when it doesn't exist (verified with a missing file — no file was created for any of the three).

`npm test` passes (15/15), and manual CLI runs against a seeded temp `habits.json` confirmed each behavior above.

NO DEFECTS
